title: 'Shin Oishinbo' Reveals Main Cast, Staff
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Tetsu Kariya 's Oishinbo manga, titled Shin Oshinbo , revealed the main cast, staff and a teaser visual on Thursday (pictured below). The anime is scheduled to premiere in 2027.

Cast Shirou Yamaoka: Youhei Azakami ( Kamonohashi Ron no Kindan Suiri ) Yuuko Kurita: Hitomi Sasaki ( Black Clover ) Yuuzan Kaibara: Akio Ootsuka ( Fate/strange Fake )

Staff Director: Kenichi Nishida ( Naruto: Shippuuden ) Series Composition: Takahiro Nagano ( Tensei shitara Ken deshita ) Character Design: Nozomi Kawashige ( Deatte 5-byou de Battle Animation Production: SynergySP , Vega Entertainment Production: Shin-Ei Animation

Kariya began writing Oishinbo in Shogakukan's Big Comic Spirits magazine in 1983, featuring art by Akira Hanasaki . Shogakukan published the 111th and latest volume in December 2014. The manga has been on hiatus since May 2014.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and published seven themed compilation volumes under its VIZ Signature imprint from January 2009 to January 2010.

Shin-Ei Animation produced a television anime based on the manga that ran for 136 episodes from October 1988 to March 1992.

title: Rudy Takes Action in Mushoku Tensei Season 3 Episode 14 Preview
content:
Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 revealed the Episode 14 preview images and synopsis ahead of its September 27 premiere. The anime entered its darkest episodes yet with the introduction of future Rudeus and his diary , with the next episode expected to conclude the arc and show how current Rudy will move forward. Crunchyroll is streaming the anime as part of its Summer 2026 lineup . You can also see the preview images and synopsis for Episode 14 “Resolve” below.

After finishing Old Rudeus’s diary, Rudeus begins taking action to protect his beloved family and prevent the tragic future that awaits them. While keeping the existence of Old Rudeus and the details surrounding him hidden from Sylphiette and Roxy, he warns them that their family may be in danger. And then, there is also the matter of “Eris”…

ALSO READ: Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation Season 3 Blu-ray Volume 2 Reveals Shirotaka Jacket Artwork Featuring Current and Future Rudeus

The main staff for the anime was previously announced and includes:

• Director: Ryosuke Shibuya

• Character Design: Sanae Shimada, Ryota Furukawa

• Music: Yoshiaki Fujisawa

• Studio: Studio Bind

You can also check out the teaser trailer for the ongoing arc below.

Season 3 began with Volume 14, for which Seven Seas describes the story: Nanahoshi, Rudeus, and the rest of their group take a trip to Perugius’s mysterious floating fortress, seeking adventure and a once-in-a-lifetime chance to learn new magic. What they find instead is disaster as one of their number is struck down by a deadly illness. How far will Rudeus go to save a dear friend’s life?

You can also see the key visual for the third season.

The anime is based on a light novel by Rifujin na Magonote with Shirotaka’s illustrations. Seven Seas is publishing the light novel in English. The series is also launching a game titled Mushoku Tensei: Jobless Reincarnation – Chronicle of Echoes this year. It is a free-to-play game with in-app purchases developed by ASOBIMO.

title: Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly Anime Streams Main Trailer for 2nd Part
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Thursday the main promotional video for the second cours (quarter of a year) of Mahō no Shimai Lulutto Lilly ( Magical Sisters Lulutto Lilly ), the new magical girl television anime that it is presenting with Studio Pierrot . The video previews the new opening theme song "Swingin' Magic" by K-pop girl group ILLIT .

The anime's second part will debut on October 4 on Tokyo MX at 10:30 p.m. JST, and will also run on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X .

The anime stars:

• May Tachibana as Fū Nonoyama/Lilly Konpeto (idol form)

• Nao Ojika as Rui Nonoyama/Lulu Mashū (idol form)

• Hiroki Nanami as Uguisu

• Ai Kayano as Azuki

• Fūka Izumi as Tōko Kandachi

• Fū Hirohara as Sena Aozono

• Hikaru Yaotome as Miitaa

• Kōhei Amasaki as Shōta Seo

• Tatsumaru Tachibana as Hisashi Kadoya

• Tomokazu Sugita as Yasuo Kandachi

• Jun Kasama as Keiichi Nonoyama

• Megumi Ōhara as Shio Nonoyama

• Aya Endō as Matsuri Hinoura

Takako Ohta and Yū Mizushima , who voiced Yū Morisawa / Creamy Mami and Toshio Ohtomo respectively in the Magical Angel Creamy Mami anime franchise , also appear in the anime as guest cast members.

Previously announced new cast members for the second part include Miyari Nemoto as Asahi Araki, Yusuke Shirai as Mucchi, and Yūko Natsuyoshi as Shiromofu.

The idol unit Lulutto Lilly, which consists of the anime's main characters Lilly Konpeto (voiced by May Tachibana ) and Lulu Mashū (voiced by Nao Ojika ) will perform the new ending theme song "Dream a la Mode."

Shintarō Dōge ( Arknights: Perish in Frost assistant director, Pet episode director) is directing the anime at Studio Pierrot , and is credited for the original character designs. Yūko Kakihara ( Blue Box , 2022 & 2024 Urusei Yatsura ) is supervising and writing the series scripts. Namiko Tori ( Pokémon: Paldean Winds sub-character designer), Hirono Nishiki ( My Dress-Up Darling episode key animator), and Asami Sodeyama ( Witchy Precure! -MIRAI DAYS- ) are designing the characters.

The anime's first part premiered on April 5 on the Tokyo MX channel, and also runs on ABC TV, TV Aichi , BS NTV , and AT-X . The anime is running for two cours , with a break in between. The anime is available on streaming services such as Ani-One and Bahamut in Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan; Anime Generation and Man-ga (television broadcast) in Italy; Anime Box in Spain; and on various services in Taiwan. Tubi also streams the anime in the United States and Canada.

Bandai Namco Filmworks ' YouTube channel started streaming the anime's first two episodes on April 18, which has subtitles in 16 languages including English. The episodes are available in North America, South America, Australia, New Zealand, Southeast Asia, and in parts of Europe, Africa, and Asia. Bandai Namco Filmworks has continued streaming the anime's episodes, with the 12th episode posted on June 27, and now has subtitles in 26 languages. As of writing, the anime's full episodes are not available in Southeast Asia.
author: ANN

title: 'Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar' Reveals Additional Cast, Theme Songs, Main Promo
content:
The official website for the Japan and France co-produced original television anime Aoki Denshou Welsh & Shedar revealed additional cast, theme songs and the main promotional video on Thursday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on October 2 at 9:25 p.m. on Tokyo MX.

Cast Zabel: Yuuko Kaida ( Gintama° ) Joris: Makoto Furukawa ( Tensei shitara Slime Datta Ken ) Bechamel: Risa Kageyama ( Black Clover )

Japanese musical artist Hironobu Kageyama ( One Punch Man 3 ) and J-pop singer Masami Okui ( Haite Kudasai, Takamine-san ) are performing the opening theme "Bokura no Mirai e". Hironobu Kageyama is performing the ending theme "Omelet." The opening theme is previewed in the main promotional video below.

Naoki Horiuchi ( Saijaku Tamer wa Gomi Hiroi no Tabi wo Hajimemashita. ) is directing the anime at Ankama and Studio Dream Catcher. Tot is penning the script and serving as series composition concept. Kenichi Yamashita ( Eris no Seihai ) is serving as Japanese version series composition, with Saori Nakashiki ( Jahy-sama wa Kujikenai! ) designing the characters. Pierre-Jean Beaudoin and Jose Pavli are composing the music.

Main PV

title: Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar Anime's Main Trailer Reveals More Cast Members, Theme Song Artists
content:
The official website for Aoki Denshō Welsh & Shedar (The Azure Legend: Welsh & Shedar ), the original television anime by French entertainment company Ankama , revealed the anime's main promotional video, new cast members, and theme song artists on Thursday.

The newly announced cast members are:

Yūko Kaida as Zabel, the powerful queen of Bonta

Makoto Furukawa as Joris, Welsh's guide and teacher, and a hero who once solved a major conflict that determined the country's fate

Risa Kayama as Bechamel, Welsh's childhood friend

Additional cast members include Wataru Takagi as Khan Karkass, and Show Hayami as Azalar.

The above video previews the anime's theme song "Bokura no Mirai e" (To Our Future) by artists Hironobu Kageyama and Masami Okui . Kageyama will also perform the ending theme song "Omelette." Kageyama & KUKO will perform the insert song "I'm in you."

The anime's staff also announced that Takuya Imakado ( The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is the series' monster designer.

The anime will premiere on October 2 on Tokyo MX at 9:25 p.m. JST (8:25 a.m. EDT).

The anime will star Rikuya Yasuda as Welsh, and Yūki Kaji as Shedar.

Naoki Horiuchi (episode director for Kingdom second season, Black Clover , Vivy -Fluorite Eye's Song- ) is directing the anime at Studio Massket . Saori Nakashiki ( Sasaki and Peeps , Tales of Wedding Rings ) is designing the characters, and Nakashiki is also one of the chief animation directors alongside Yoshiaki Tsubata ( Date A Live IV ) and Yuki Ikeda ( WAVE!! -Let's go surfing!! movie trilogy).

Eri Suzuki ( Black Summoner ) is the color key artist, and Studio Massket is also in charge of anime background art. Lucas Cisterne (3D CG for The Weakest Tamer Began a Journey to Pick Up Trash ) is in charge of art setting, Jun Watanabe ( Ascendance of a Bookworm ) is directing the sound at TO Books , and Pierre-Jean Beaudoin & Jose Pavli are composing the music. Tot is credited for the original work, scripts, and drafting the series story outline. Kenichi Yamashita ( MF Ghost ) is in charge of the series scripts for the anime's Japanese version.

Ankama is an independent entertainment and digital creation group most widely known for the DOFUS tactical MMORPG, which launched in 2004. The company also published Atsushi Kaneko 's SOIL manga , and Suguro Chayamachi 's Togainu no Chi manga in French.
author: ANN

title: 'Phantom Busters' TV Anime Announced For 2027
content:
A television anime adaptation of Shoco 's Phantom Busters manga was announced on Thursday through the anime's official website, revealing a commemorative illustration from Shoco (pictured to the right).

Shoco originally published the manga as a one-shot in Jump SQ.Rise magazine in the fall 2022 season before beginning serialization in Jump SQ. in August 2023. The seventh volume was released in February 2026, with the eighth one scheduled to be released on October 2. The manga has over 1.4 million copies in circulation, including digital editions.

VIZ Media licensed the manga in English and released the first volume in October 2025, the series is also published digitally through VIZ Media's Shonen Jump imprint.

Synopsis In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Koutarou Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro's got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters? (Source: VIZ Media)

title: 'Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu II' Announces Additional Cast Pair
content:
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Nana Mikoshiba 's Hyouken no Majutsushi ga Sekai wo Suberu ( The Iceblade Sorcerer Shall Rule the World ) light novel announced an additional pair of cast for its second season on Thursday. The new season is scheduled to premiere on TBS on October 9 at 1.28 a.m., followed by BS11 at 11.00 p.m. on the same day.

Voice actors Kazuyuki Okitsu ( Hidarikiki no Eren ) and Shiki Aoki ( Helck ) are joining the second season as Elliot Arkwright and Maria Bradley, respectively.

Masahiro Takata ( Nageki no Bourei wa Intai shitai ) directs the second season at Zero-G , also handling the series composition and sound director. Masahiro Takata ( Bananya ), Tomoko Shinozuka ( Wotaku ni Koi wa Muzukashii ), and Takahito Oonishi (Watashi no Shiawase na Kekkon) are penning the script. Mariko Kawamoto ( Mahou Shoujo Taisen ) is designing the characters. Tatsuhiko Saiki ( Otome Game no Hametsu Flag shika Nai Akuyaku Reijou ni Tensei shiteshimatta... X ) and Natsumi Tabuchi ( Adachi to Shimamura ) are composing the music.

Produced by Cloud Hearts , the first season aired as a 12-episode series in Winter 2023. Crunchyroll simulcast the anime with subtitles and dubs in multiple languages.

Mikoshiba began writing the light novel on the Shousetsuka ni Narou website in October 2019. Kodansha began publishing the novel under its Ranobe Bunko imprint in July 2020, with illustrations by Riko Korie . The ninth volume shipped on June 2.

Norihito Sasaki began a manga adaptation in Magazine pocket in June 2020. Kodansha shipped the 16th volume in April 2024.

Kodansha USA licensed the manga in English in October 2021. The 13th volume went on sale on June 2.

title: Neoshoco's Phantom Busters Manga Gets TV Anime in 2027
content:
A website opened on Thursday to announce that Neoshoco 's Phantom Busters manga is getting a television anime adaptation that will air in 2027. Neoshoco drew an illustration to commemorate the news.

Why bother fighting spectral foes like all the other exorcists when you can just eat them?

Straight A student Eugene Korekishi doesn't believe in ghosts…but his classmate Mogari Shishikuno is an exorcist who swallows them whole! Mogari can't see ghosts on his own, but once he and Eugene meet someone with the sight, there's only one path left—form an exorcist club at school and embark on a high school life that's anything but normal!

In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Kotaro Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro's got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters ?

Neoshoco launched the manga in Jump SQ. in 2023. Shueisha published the seventh compiled volume on February 4 and will publish the eighth volume on October 2. Viz Media released the fourth volume on July 7, and will release the fifth volume on October 6.

Viz Media 's Shonen Jump app and Shueisha 's MANGA Plus service are both releasing the manga digitally in English.

The manga has more than 1.4 million copies in circulation, including digital copies sold.

title: Phantom Busters Anime Adaptation Announced for 2027
content:
Neoshoco’s Phantom Busters manga is officially getting a TV anime adaptation in 2027, as announced by the official X account on September 24. The announcement was previously teased with a graphic and the scheduled time, which was set for 18:00 JST. Neoshoco commented: “The anime adaptation is happening, yay! It’s all thanks to the readers. Thank you so much! I think Phantom Busters is the kind of series whose fun will stand out even more when animated, so as the author, I’m truly happy that it has become a reality! Please look forward to seeing the Phantom Busters moving around and having fun!” You can see the teaser illustration by the author below.

Phantom Busters is a Japanese manga series written and illustrated by Neoshoco. It has been serialized in Shueisha’s Jump Square since August 2023, while VIZ Media began publishing the English version in October 2025. The manga has surpassed 1.4 million copies in circulation, including digital editions. Volume 8 is scheduled for release in Japan on October 2. VIZ describes the story: In search of a fourth member for the club, Mogari, Eugene, and new recruit Kaoru Kanzaki set their sights on Kotaro Tamon, a classmate who seems to be able to talk to ghosts. Unfortunately, Kotaro’s got some major problems communicating with living humans! Will Kotaro be able to overcome his anxiety and join the Phantom Busters?

title: Star Detective Precure! Film Opens at #3, Cosmic Princess Kaguya! Returns at #6 in Japan
content:
Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, stayed at #1 in its ninth weekend in Japan's box office from Friday to Sunday. The film sold 643,000 tickets from Friday to Sunday, and earned 999 million yen (about US$6.31 million). As of Wednesday, September 23 (the end of Japan's "Silver Week" string of holidays), the film has sold 11.33 million tickets to earn 16.5 billion yen (about US$104.3 million).

The film is currently the biggest film in Japan this year, and now ranks 15th in Japan's all-time box office ranking.

Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu opened on July 24 and ranked at #1 for its opening weekend. The film earned 990 million yen (about US$6.05 million) on its opening day. The film sold 1,508,500 tickets and earned 2,240,333,500 yen (about US$13.70 million) in its first three days.

The film's 4DX screenings began on September 5. One-day-only cheering screenings for the film took place on September 11. Penlight screenings took place on September 23.

The film is based on the manga's arc posted on X (formerly Twitter ) from March to November 2023, nicknamed the "Siren Arc" or "Island Arc."

Nagano is credited for the original story and also wrote the film's script. Under Nagano 's supervision, Kei Oikawa ( Uma Musume Pretty Derby 3 seasons, Hinamatsuri , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU TOO! , My Teen Romantic Comedy SNAFU Climax ) directed the film at Cygames Pictures . QTORY inc. managed the production, and TOHO is distributing the film.

Eiga Meitantei Precure! Fushigi na Niwa to Futari no Himitsu ( Star Detective Precure! The Movie: The Mysterious Garden and the Secret of 2 People) — the film for Star Detective Precure! , the 23rd main anime entry in the Precure franchise — ranked at #3 in its opening weekend. The film sold 358,000 tickets to earn 446 million yen (about US$2.82 million) in its first three days. In its first six days until September 23, the film sold 606,000 tickets and earned 746 million yen (about US$4.71 million).

The film opened in Japan on September 18.

The cast members who voice the film's original characters are Akari Kitō as Karin, a 14-year-old girl who holds the key to the story; Nobunaga Shimazaki as Alan, a fairy who watches over Karin; and Kōki Uchiyama as Rain, a fairy who requests the Detective Precures' help

Hanako Ueda ( You and Idol Precure♪ , Summer Time Rendering , My Hero Academia FINAL SEASON episode director) directed the film. Yoshimi Narita ( Eiga HappinessCharge PreCure! Ningyō no Kuni no Ballerina , Eiga Precure All Stars New Stage 3: Eien no Tomodachi , Eiga Tropical-Rouge! Precure: Yuki no Princess to Kiseki no Yubiwa! films) wrote the script, Erika Fukasawa ( Eiga Kimi to Idol Precure♪ Omatase! Kimi ni Todokeru Kirakkilive! ) and Misaki Umase ( You and Idol Precure♪ ) composed the music, and Emiko Miyamoto ( Eiga Precure All Stars F , Precure Super Stars! original character designer) designed the characters and was also the film's chief animation director.

Yūka Masui and Chihaya Yoshitake perform the film's ending theme song "FIRST PRISM." Ami Ishii performs the insert song "First Step."

Shingo Yamashita 's Cosmic Princess Kaguya! ( Chō Kaguya-hime! ) anime film returned to theaters on September 18 with a new MX4D, 4DX, SCREENX, ULTRA 4DX, and Dolby Atmos screening , which debuted at #6. As of September 22, the film has sold more than 1.5 million tickets and has earned a cumulative 3.0 billion yen (about US$19.0 million).

The film's first limited theatrical run started on February 20. Tickets quickly sold out, with some theaters having to increase the number of screenings to more than 10 times a day. The film's limited one-week theatrical screening run in Japan was extended , and finally ended on June 18.

Netflix began streaming the film on January 22.

The film features songs by Vocaloid producers Ryo ( supercell ), kz ( Livetune ), 40mP , HoneyWorks , Aqu3ra , and yuigot .

Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie: Walpurgisnacht: Rising ( Gekijōban Mahō Shōjo Madoka Magica: Walpurgis no Kaiten ), the official sequel to the Puella Magi Madoka Magica The Movie Part 3: Rebellion film, dropped from #4 to #8 in its fourth weekend.

The film got IMAX screenings in Japan on August 28, the same day it opened in theaters. The film sold 535,000 tickets and and earned 939,647,100 yen (about US$5.95 million) in its first three days.

Yukihiro Miyamoto ( Puella Magi Madoka Magica , Magia Record: Puella Magi Madoka Magica Side Story , Arakawa Under the Bridge ) directed the film.

Shion Wakayama voices the new magical girl Shichōka and Tomoyo Kurosawa voices Selma Therese.

The anime film features a returning staff from the original anime series and films, including original creators Magica Quartet , chief director Akiyuki Simbo , scriptwriter Gen Urobuchi of Nitroplus , original character designer Ume Aoki , animation character designer Junichirō Taniguchi , composer Yuki Kajiura , alternate space designer Gekidan Inu Curry , and animation studio SHAFT .

The live-action film of Tatsuki Fujimoto 's " Look Back " one-shot manga dropped from #5 to #10 in its second weekend.

The film opened on September 11 in Japan, earning 144,146,120 yen (about US929,800) in its first three days.

Aju Makita ( Child of Kamiari Month , Happiness ) plays Kyōmoto, while Natsuki Deguchi ( I Have a S/e/c/r/e/t/, Blue Spring Ride ) plays Fujino in the film.

Hirokazu Kore-eda ( Shoplifters , Our Little Sister , Air Doll ) directed and edited the film, and also wrote the screenplay. Yūta Bandō ( BELLE , Kaiju No. 8 , also known as Taku Matsushiba ) composed the music.

Musician Kenshi Yonezu , actress and singer Tōko Miura , and animator and director Yōko Kuno have special guest staff roles in the film. Yonezu performs guitar for the film, credited under the "Shark Kick Guitar" moniker, while Miura performs vocals for an insert song in the film. Kuno directed a rotoscoped animation sequence based on their performance, with Shinei Animation producing the animation.

Sound! Euphonium, The Final Movie Part 2 ( Saishū Gakushō Hibike! Euphonium Kōhen ) dropped off the top 10 in its second weekend.
author: ANN
